name: pi-omp-skills-autocomplete
description: $skill autocomplete extensions for Oh My Pi and plain pi.

scripts.check: bun -e 'const result = await Bun.build({ entrypoints: ["./omp-skills-autocomplete.ts", "./pi-skills-autocomplete.ts"], target: "bun", external: ["*"], write: false }); if (!result.success) { for (const log of result.logs) console.error(log); process.exit(1); }'
